title: Guidance for Industry: Food Labeling Guide (landing page)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guide last revised January 2013, page content current as of 15 Jan 2025; allergen and nutrition chapters under revision; FDA does not pre-approve labels.

title: A Food Labeling Guide (full PDF)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF saved and read as text). PDP and information panel definitions; identity and net quantity on the PDP; 1/16 inch minimum type; no intervening material (a UPC barcode counts); net quantity in the bottom 30% of the PDP in metric and US units; PDP area rules and the net quantity type-size table.

title: Food Allergies
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Nine major food allergens, sesame added by the FASTER Act from 1 Jan 2023; declare in parentheses or a Contains statement; content current as of 11 Mar 2026.

title: Front-of-Package Nutrition Labeling
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Proposed (not final) Nutrition Info box rating saturated fat, sodium and added sugars; comment period extended to 15 Jul 2025; content current as of 8 May 2025.

title: Use of the "Healthy" Claim on Food Labeling
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Final rule announced 19 Dec 2024; a "healthy" symbol still in development; content current as of 16 Jan 2025.

title: Fair Packaging and Labeling Act
supports: Opened with WebFetch. FPLA labels must show net contents, identity of the commodity, and name and place of business; FTC coverage excludes food, drugs, devices and cosmetics.

title: Green Guides (16 CFR Part 260)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guides for environmental marketing claims; most recent version listed is from October 2012.

title: Packaging EPR (SB 54)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. SB 54 packaging EPR in force; Circular Action Alliance approved as producer responsibility organisation and submitted its plan on 13 Oct 2026; covered material categories list due for update by 1 Jan 2027.

title: Food labelling: giving food information to consumers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. UK mandatory information on prepacked food; minimum x-height 1.2 mm (0.9 mm if largest surface under 80 cm2); name, net quantity and alcohol in the same field of vision; Northern Ireland follows EU rules; updated 20 Sep 2022.

title: Food information: net quantity labelling
publisher: GOV.UK (Office for Product Safety and Standards)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Metric units, imperial no more prominent; drained net weight; same field of vision as the name; multipack format; e-mark voluntary; updated 8 Jul 2021.

title: Packaged goods: weights and measures regulations
publisher: GOV.UK (Office for Product Safety and Standards)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The three packers rules; the e-mark is voluntary and still recognised after 1 Jan 2021; updated 20 Sep 2024.

title: Allergen guidance for food businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The 14 allergens; allergens emphasised every time they appear in the ingredients list; PPDS labels need a full ingredients list with allergens emphasised; updated 17 Jul 2026.

title: Food labelling: general rules
supports: Opened with WebFetch. EU mandatory particulars; x-height 1.2 mm (0.9 mm under 80 cm2); packs under 10 cm2 need four items; allergens emphasised; last checked 13 Jul 2026.

title: Food information to consumers: legislation
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Regulation 1169/2011 applied from 13 Dec 2014, nutrition from 13 Dec 2016; planned revision (front-of-pack nutrition, origin, date marking, alcohol); factsheets Feb 2026.

title: Using the e-mark on prepackaged products
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Voluntary e-mark for 5 g/ml to 10 kg/l; placed next to the quantity, at least 3 mm high; last checked 12 Oct 2026.

title: Packaging waste
supports: Opened with WebFetch. PPWR is Regulation (EU) 2025/40, in force 11 Feb 2025, applies from 12 Aug 2026; all packaging recyclable by 2030; PFAS limits in food-contact packaging; FAQ Aug 2026 and guidelines Mar 2026.

title: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation: implementation
supports: Opened with WebFetch. PPWR timeline: implementing acts on harmonised labels due 12 Aug 2026 (Art. 12(6), 13(2)); design-for-recycling criteria 1 Jan 2028; empty space ratio methodology 12 Feb 2028.

title: Extended producer responsibility for packaging: small businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Producers under 10 tonnes a year may get lighter conditions; register where packaging becomes waste; authorised representative rule applies since Aug 2026, suspension for small businesses proposed; platforms will ask for registration numbers once registers exist.

title: Facts about the new EU rules on packaging and packaging waste
supports: Opened with WebFetch. New labels with sorting information; unnecessary single-use packaging banned in 2030; 90% separate collection of single-use plastic and metal drinks containers by 2029; online shops to cut empty space.

title: Extended producer responsibility for packaging: who is affected and what to do
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Obligated if UK-established, over 25 tonnes and turnover of GBP 1 million or more; large producers over 50 tonnes and GBP 2 million; large producer duties; records kept 7 years; updated 19 Aug 2026.

title: EPR for packaging: what you must do as a small producer
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Small producers register and report each year by 1 April; no waste disposal fees or PRNs; only a director, company secretary, partner or LLP member can create the account; updated 22 Oct 2026.

title: Recyclability assessment methodology: how to assess your packaging waste
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Red, amber and green ratings across 8 material categories; large producers from 1 Jan 2025; the rating affects the disposal fee; automatic red cases; updated 4 Sep 2025.

title: EPR for packaging: how to assess household and non-household packaging
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Primary and shipment packaging count as household unless conditions are met; evidence kept 7 years; labelling alone is not evidence; updated 5 Aug 2025.

title: How our labels work
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Binary Recycle and Do Not Recycle labels in line with ISO 14021; 75% and 50% local authority collection thresholds; Check Home Collections; multi-component labels; labels made in the members-only tool.

title: How2Recycle
supports: Opened with WebFetch. On-pack label with Widely Recyclable, Check Locally, Store Drop-off (US only) and Not Yet Recyclable; US and Canada; membership; new Pro Label announced without dates.

title: Artwork Tips & Tricks
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dieline templates; 300 PPI; CMYK; 100% black for text and scannable codes; rich black for large solids; vector formats; inside print files; proof within 24 hours, auto-approved on the fourth business day.

title: Artwork Support
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Separate artwork, dieline and white layers; outline text; embed images; CMYK; overprint; supply a white layer; barcode black on white; Canva files not accepted as final artwork; 0.125 inch bleed per side.

title: Barcode placement and printing guidelines
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Barcode on the back, lower right; away from edges; quiet zones; do not scale existing art; black on white; avoid red bars; single ink.

title: How to Get a UPC Barcode
supports: Opened with WebFetch. License a single GTIN or a company prefix; every variation needs its own barcode (3 sizes x 3 colours = 9).

title: Canva MCP server
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Canva MCP lets an AI assistant create, edit and search designs, use brand kits and templates, export PDF and other formats, resize and comment.
